name: Juan Sebastián Sánchez Urbano
headline: Junior Data Engineer · ETL Automation, Cloud (AWS), Machine Learning & AI
summary: Industrial Automation Engineer and Master's student in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence, with a Junior Data Engineer profile. I design and build ETL pipelines with medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold), work with relational databases (SQL, MySQL), program in Python and R, and develop automation workflows with n8n, REST APIs and AI agents. I combine industrial engineering with data analytics to ensure the integrity, availability and quality of information, under continuous improvement methodologies (PDCA). I maintain a public portfolio with projects, my own tools and data, automation and 3D printing services.
